units.source_text: 岳母想道：“我的女儿已死，悲伤也是枉然。

en.t: The mother-in-law thought, "My daughter is dead, and grief is useless now.

units.source_text: 倒是这个女婿，人品如此十全其美，而为他人所有，实甚可悲。

en.t: But this son-in-law, whose character is so perfectly admirable, now belongs to someone else, and that is truly sad.

units.source_text: 我的女儿为什么连一点遗念也不留呢？”

en.t: Why did my daughter leave behind not even the slightest lingering attachment?"

units.source_text: 她私心怜爱这女婿，觉得他虽然难得来访，也很可欣慰，便不待探问，把心事都说出来。

en.t: Privately she cherished this son-in-law, and because even his rare visits brought her comfort, she poured out her feelings before he had even asked.

units.source_text: 至于那浮舟呢，也有她自己的许多回忆，那沉思冥想之态，异常可怜。

en.t: As for Ukifune, she too had many memories of her own, and her deeply pensive look was exceedingly pitiful.

units.source_text: 她身穿一件毫无风趣的寻常白色衫子。

en.t: She was wearing an ordinary white robe with no charm at all.

units.source_text: 裙子也是黑沉沉的，毫无光彩，大约是模仿这里的人常穿的桧皮色裙子吧。

en.t: Her skirt too was dark and dull, without the least brightness, probably in imitation of the cypress-bark-colored skirts commonly worn by the women here.

units.source_text: 她自己觉得：连服装也大异于往昔，样子多难看啊！

en.t: She herself felt that even her clothes were utterly different from before, and wondered how unbecoming she must look.

units.source_text: 然而她穿这种粗劣的布衣草裳，姿态反而更美。

en.t: Yet dressed in such rough cloth garments and rustic skirts, her figure looked all the more beautiful.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧身边的侍女说：“近来我们似乎都觉得已故的小姐复活了。

en.t: A maid attending the younger nun said, "Lately we all seem to feel that the young lady who died has come back to life.

units.source_text: 今天竟又看到中将大人来访，真叫人不胜感慨！

en.t: And today, to see His Lordship the Captain visit again fills us with emotion beyond words.

units.source_text: 反正都要婚嫁的，何妨就叫他娶了现在这位小姐？

en.t: Since she must marry someone in any case, why not have him marry this young lady now?

units.source_text: 两人真是一对天生佳偶呢。”

en.t: The two of them truly seem like a match made in heaven."

units.source_text: 浮舟听到这话，想道：“哎呀，不好了！

en.t: When Ukifune heard this, she thought, "Oh no, this is terrible.

units.source_text: 我在这世间活下来，如果嫁了人，不管其人如何，总要使我回想起过去的恨事。

en.t: If I go on living in this world and marry someone, no matter what kind of man he is, he will surely make me recall the sorrows of the past.

units.source_text: 今后我定要完全忘却此种事情。”

en.t: From now on, I must forget such things completely."
